fusions.name: Anchor Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a chain at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and springs along it to the target, where it deals 12 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ricochet Hooves
fusions.desc: Kicks out around you and deals 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit then jumps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Slip the Tether
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles, and for 3 seconds blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
